name: Chess Connect - Rapid - Bangalore Chess Club
description:
## Event Details

Join us for the next edition of  **Chess Connect**

Enjoy a day of friendly rapid chess, connect with fellow chess enthusiasts, and a lot of fun. Whether you’re a regular tournament player or just getting back to the board, Chess Connect is designed to be fun, social, and welcoming for all levels.

Great games, good vibes, and exciting rewards await you at the board.
